records.title: Security Incident Update #2 (2026-10-30)
records.notes: Binance states >$6.34B company funds set aside, ~$5B held in affected token assets, ~$1.34B remaining to acquire through market/OTC, ~$3B frozen; initial PoR snapshot target within 12 hours and results by Nov 2. No XRP-specific purchase allocation disclosed.

records.title: XRPL Escrow Schedule and History
records.notes: Provider reports pinned ledger 108021679 at 2026-10-31 10:50 UTC; 1B XRP scheduled to become finishable at 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC across two escrow objects; ~31.4B XRP in 98 objects across eight accounts. Prior 12 months: 12B released, 8.4B re-escrowed, 3.6B net outside escrow. Oct 1: 1B released, 700M re-escrowed, 300M left outside escrow. Net outside escrow is not evidence of sale.

records.title: Escrow on the XRP Ledger
records.notes: Protocol documentation describes time/condition-based escrow and EscrowFinish mechanics. A scheduled FinishAfter time does not prove that funds were finished, sold or entered exchange liquidity.

records.title: XRP Derivatives Market Dashboard
records.notes: Captured panel: XRP ~$1.2455; OI ~$1.85B; OI 24h +0.33%; funding +0.0061% per 8h; 24h liquidations >=$2.90M, long ~$1.82M and short ~$1.07M; long-account share 78.5%; seven-exchange scope. Account share is not notional exposure; OI universe is provider-specific.

records.title: XRP ETF Issuer-File Flow Dashboard
records.notes: Oct 30 partial flow approximately -$866K from two of four reported funds; Oct 29 approximately +$3.678M from four funds. Latest issuer-file refresh observed 2026-10-31 02:07 UTC. Partial coverage; do not treat as final or combine with other aggregators.

records.title: XRP ETF Flow Dashboard
records.notes: Latest displayed completed data through Oct 29: daily +$8.4M and 30-session cumulative +$98.9M across its five-fund universe. Oct 30 not yet included in this displayed series at retrieval. Different fund universe and cutoff from CryptoKeyhole.

records.title: SBI Group and Visa Launch Crypto-Rewards Credit Card
records.publisher: SBI Holdings / SBI VC Trade / Aplus / Visa Japan
records.notes: Card points automatically and without exchange fees convert to a selected asset: BTC, ETH or XRP. VCTRADE account required. Also supports crypto rewards on SBI Securities mutual-fund card accumulation. No reward volume or XRP sourcing method disclosed.

records.title: SBI VISA Crypto Card BIZ for Business Representatives and Sole Proprietors
records.publisher: SBI Holdings / SBI VC Trade / Aplus
records.notes: Extends the crypto-rewards card to corporate/organization representatives and sole proprietors; payment account may be personal or corporate. Applicant is the representative/sole proprietor. The source does not disclose aggregate XRP conversion or market sourcing.

records.title: SBI VC Trade Begins Handling RLUSD
records.publisher: SBI Holdings / SBI VC Trade / Ripple
records.notes: VCTRADE lists RLUSD and supports fee-free deposits/withdrawals, but explicitly supports Ethereum chain only; XRPL RLUSD deposits/withdrawals are not supported by this VCTRADE service at launch. VCTRADE had already listed USDC in March 2025. The release describes SBI/Ripple cooperation since 2016.

records.title: SBI Holdings Participation in Circle ARC Token Presale
records.notes: SBI says it acquired Circle shares equivalent to USD 50M as a strategic investment following Circle's NYSE listing and participated in the ARC token presale. The amount of ARC presale participation is not disclosed; the $50M is Circle equity, not XRP capital.

records.title: SBI Holdings and SMFG Capital/Business Alliance to Explore Stablecoin-Based Financial Services
records.notes: Official announcement describes a capital/business partnership and joint consideration of new financial services using stablecoins. This is exploratory; no production stablecoin product, transaction volume or XRP demand is established by the announcement.

records.title: SBI, Startale and BlackRock MOU on Tokenized MMF and JPYSC Ecosystem
records.notes: MOU to explore a digital-asset ecosystem using a tokenized money-market fund and JPYSC. This is a framework/intent, not evidence that a production fund, collateral facility or settlement flow is live.

records.title: SBI and Startale Join Open Standard; Explore JPYSC/OUSD Interoperability
records.notes: SBI and Startale join Open Standard, which the release says has 140+ participants including Coinbase, Visa, Stripe, Mastercard and BlackRock. They are considering a JPYSC/OUSD interoperability PoC. Shared consortium membership is not a direct bilateral Coinbase-SBI commercial contract.

records.title: SBI Signs Agreement and Framework for 100% Bitbank Acquisition
records.notes: SBI signed a framework and share-transfer agreement to acquire 100% of Bitbank, subject to Japan Fair Trade Commission clearance and other conditions. Closing was scheduled for October 2026. No official completion announcement was located by the 2026-10-31 cutoff. Earlier ledger wording that treated Oct 1 completion as confirmed is superseded. The projected ¥1.1T assets/2.92M accounts were simple April 2026 combined figures conditional on completion.

records.title: SBI START Security-Token Bond Offering with XRP Rewards
records.notes: ¥10B SBI START security-token bond issued on ibet for Fin; XRP rewards are tied to subscription/holding terms and VCTRADE account eligibility. XRP is a reward asset, not the bond settlement rail. Exact total XRP reward distribution and sourcing from inventory versus market purchase are not disclosed.

records.title: SBI Holdings Shareholder Benefit Including XRP Exchange Coupon
records.notes: Eligible domestic shareholders may receive an XRP exchange coupon, with tiered yen-equivalent benefits (including ¥2,000 and ¥8,000 levels) subject to shareholding and account requirements. Coupon value is not a disclosed market purchase quantity; aggregate redemption is unknown.

records.title: SBI Shinsei Bank Yen Deposit Campaign with XRP Exchange Voucher
records.publisher: SBI Shinsei Bank / SBI VC Trade
records.notes: Historical campaign offered XRP exchange vouchers up to ¥20,000 for qualifying six-month yen deposits of at least ¥300,000. Campaign ended March 31, 2026; it is not a current live offer and does not disclose XRP sourcing.

records.title: SBI VC Trade Announces Two Million Registered Accounts
records.notes: Company reports 2M registered accounts and describes stablecoin, lending and corporate/large-client services. Registered accounts are not necessarily unique active customers or XRP holders.

records.title: SBI JPYSC Issuance, Reserve and Lending Update
records.publisher: SBI Holdings / SBI VC Trade / SBI Shinsei Trust
records.notes: Company-reported JPYSC issuance around ¥20.1B, approximately ¥1B in short-term Japanese government bonds and approximately ¥6.9B lending applications. These are JPYSC reserve/credit metrics, not XRP collateral or XRP capital flows.

records.title: SBI and Startale Launch JPYSC, Initially Account-Bound
records.publisher: SBI Holdings / SBI Shinsei Trust / SBI VC Trade / Startale
records.notes: SBI Shinsei Trust is issuer, SBI VC Trade distributor, Startale co-developer. Initial use is restricted to VCTRADE accounts with no external-wallet withdrawal; public-chain circulation is intended after legal/tax practice and supervisory confirmation. Not a live public-chain XRP or XRPL route.

records.title: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. Company Profile
records.publisher: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (SBIC East Japan)
records.notes: Identifies the company as Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (SBIC East Japan), established 1963, capital ¥6.6734B, shareholders include 18 prefectural/local public bodies, chambers, financial institutions and businesses. It is not SBI Holdings.

records.title: Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Company Act
records.notes: The law identifies three sister companies: Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka. The acronym SBIC is not evidence of affiliation with SBI Holdings. The exact original meaning of the user's phrase 'ChatGPT SBIC' remains unresolved.

records.title: Circle Launches Arc Mainnet
records.notes: Circle identifies SBI Group as a founding validator, Coinbase as an exchange-access partner and Morpho as a credit-layer participant. Arc uses USDC as native gas; 10B ARC genesis mint is not a commitment to public token launch. Arc is distinct from XRPL and is not an XRP-native network.

records.title: SBI Holdings and Circle Strategic Partnership for USDC in Japan
records.notes: Circle and SBI announced a USDC/Japan/Web3 MOU; subsequent 2025 disclosures describe Circle SBI Japan KK as a 50/50 joint venture. SBI VC Trade began USDC distribution in Japan in March 2025.

records.title: Circle Supported Chains and Currencies
records.notes: Circle's supported-chain table lists XRPL (API chain code XRP) for USDC and indicates support for Circle Mint-related deposit/payout APIs. This is Circle infrastructure support; it does not imply SBI VCTRADE uses XRPL for its RLUSD service.

records.title: SBI Group and Solana Foundation Strategic Partnership for On-Chain Finance
records.notes: SBI and Solana Foundation announced a strategic partnership; Solana Foundation participates in the SBI R3 Japan successor structure alongside SBI and SMFG. This is a parallel chain strategy, not an XRP integration or proof of XRP abandonment.

records.title: SBI Clearing Trust Merger into SBI Shinsei Trust — Planned December 31
records.publisher: SBI Holdings / SBI Shinsei Bank / SBI Shinsei Trust
records.notes: SBI announced a planned absorption merger effective Dec 31, 2026 to consolidate trust/custody expertise. SBI Clearing Trust began accepting crypto-asset trust custody in 2023; SBI Shinsei Trust issues JPYSC. The merger is planned, not yet effective, and does not disclose XRP-specific custody balances.
